Visa | Software Engineer | Bangalore | May 2025 [Selected]
# About Me

- **Education**: B.Tech in ECE from NIT (2024 Graduate)
- **Years of Experience**: 10 months at a product-based startup

---

### **Round 1: CodeSignal Assessment**
- Format: 4 coding questions  
  - 1 Easy  
  - 1 Medium  
  - 1 Medium-Hard  
  - 1 Hard  
- **Outcome**: Solved all of them successfully.

---

### **Round 2: Technical Interview (20th May)**
- **Type**: Purely discussion-based (Approx. 1 hour)
- **What Happened**:
  - **Deep dive into resume and past work** (~30 mins)  
  - Detailed discussion on projects and contributions at the current company  
    - For example, when Kafka was mentioned:  
      - Why Kafka?  
      - Alternatives?  
      - Architecture-level questions and trade-offs  
  - **1 DSA Question**:
    - **Problem**: Given a log file with timestamps and IPs, rate-limit IPs making more than _x_ requests in a 10-minute window.
    - Started with: What is a **DDoS attack**? How to prevent it?
    - Approach discussed: **Sliding Window**
    - **Follow-up**: What if the log file is in GBs?
      - Suggested solution: Use **external sorting** to process large-scale data

---

### **Round 3: Technical Interview (22nd May)**
- **Deep dive into resume, tech stack, and projects** (~40 mins)
  - Detailed questions on:
    - Project architecture
    - Tech stack decisions
    - Work at the current company
- **DSA Question**:
  - A variation of the **Aggressive Cows** problem ([SPoJ – AGGRCOW](https://www.spoj.com/problems/AGGRCOW/))  
  - Required applying **binary search on answers**. Wrote code with all edge cases covered.

---

### **Round 4: Hiring Manager Round (26th May)**
- **Got grilled on resume and system design** (~40 mins)
  - In-depth discussion on:
    - Work done at current company
    - System architecture choices
    - Scalability and performance trade-offs
  - Used **Excalidraw** to draw and explain architecture
- **Behavioral Questions** covering collaboration, ownership, decision-making
- Ended with me asking questions about the team, role expectations, and future direction

---

- Received **positive feedback** the next day.



## Compensation 
Read the compensation  here: [Visa Compensation Details – May 2025](https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/6817743/visa-offer-software-engineer-banglore-by-trjz/

HIRED by VISA!!! for SUMMER INTERN!!!!!:-)
Visa recently visited my campus. So, It first held an OA on codesignal platform. The test could be attempted from home. There were 4 questions and 70 minutes were given to attempt it. The question were at max leetcode medium level. No special data structure was needed, simply based on arrays, strings and maps. I was able to solve all 4 in 50 minutes.Then, I got shortlisted for interview out of around 500 students. A total of 11 students were selected for this. Then an online interview was held. I was the first one to give this interview.It went for 57 minutes. There was only one round. The whole interview went around the project I had made, the technologiews I know. Some HR questions were thrown during the resume discussion. Then at half time, interviewer gave me a DSA question to solve, which was quite easy. Just count the number of repeating words in a given text string(Didn't need to even handle any edge cases). Could be easily solved with an unordered_map. So it went well overall. And just the next day, I got selected. 9 out of 11 were selected, so the main competition was the OA.I am really happy to be selected for this opportunity.
Stipend is 90k per month(+1lakh reclocation bonus)
This is a 2 month summer intern.
Best of luck to all.

# VISA Inc Interview Experience for Software Engineering Internship 2022

Last Updated : 23 Jul, 2025

VISA came to our campus for a software engineering profile for the 2022 summer internship, and it was open for CSE, EE, and MTH branches only.

****Interview Process :****

****Round 1:**** Online Coding Round 

Time: 75 Mins

2 coding problems were asked: 

1. [Find length of longest subsequence of one string which is](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/find-length-longest-subsequence-one-string-substring-another-string/) [substring of another string](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/find-length-longest-subsequence-one-string-substring-another-string/)
2. https://leetcode.com/problems/graph-connectivity-with-threshold/

Candidates who solved both the questions in the first 45 mins get shortlisted. 12 candidates including me got shortlisted.

****Round 2:**** HR + Technical Round

Time: 60 Minutes

Firstly we greet each other and then we have talked about my projects and stuff. After that, he gave me 5 coding questions and I have to choose any three of them and write the code for them. I finished with all three questions in about 15-20 min since I have solved similar questions while practicing.

Those 5 Questions are:

1. [Snake and Ladder Problem](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/snake-ladder-problem-2/)
2. [Second most repeated word in a sequence](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/second-repeated-word-sequence/)
3. [Replace every element with the greatest element on right side](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/replace-every-element-with-the-greatest-on-right-side/)
4. [N-Queens](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/n-queen-problem-backtracking-3/)
5. [Special Keyboard](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/how-to-print-maximum-number-of-a-using-given-four-keys/)

After solving those questions we have discussed our city since I and the interviewer both are from the same city, after that we were finished with the interview. After a very stressful night, the Next day results were declared and 7 out of 12 candidates including me got selected for the internship.

****Tips:****Be calm and believe in your preparation, you will definitely get good results.Cheers and all the best for the Interviews.
